evidence_kind: Read-only source and literature review; no new training or live-cluster evidence
verified_observations: Laya local adapter freezes encoder and act_head; remaining trainable modules include transformer decision-head layers.
GLiNER local adapter trains classifier parameters only and encodes under torch.no_grad.
Both inspected 10-epoch local configurations specify max_len=2048; this is configuration evidence, not a newly inspected live run.
Pinned Laya source caps individual option descriptions at 48 tokens and separately budgets question instructions.
Pinned Laya model config defaults to max_len=512 and head_max_len=192; the local training view overrides sequence construction length.
Pinned GLiNER Decide config specifies architecture=span and model_name=microsoft/deberta-v3-large.
The inspected root checkpoints are English-oriented; multilingual variants require explicit separate experiment arms.
Current adapters use routing labels and prefix/tail state truncation; semantic candidate adapters are proposed, not implemented.

limits: Upstream model-card comparisons are author-reported operational classification results, not semantic retrieval evidence.
No evidence justifies choosing GLiNER or Laya as the best candidate before matched retrieval experiments.
Encoder-adaptation training, LoRA support for the new adapters, and memory requirements remain to be tested.
Neither the original main worktree nor its uncommitted GLiNER code was changed by this review.
